local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

------------------------------------------------
-- LIMPEZA
------------------------------------------------

local oldGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("SpiderUI")
if oldGui then
	oldGui:Destroy()
end

------------------------------------------------
-- CONFIGURAÇÕES
------------------------------------------------

local SWING_ANIM = "rbxassetid://507767968"
local SWING_SOUND = "rbxassetid://1284846268"
local ZIP_SOUND = "rbxassetid://9084017080"

-- ANIMAÇÃO DE ESCALADA R15
local CLIMB_ANIM = "rbxassetid://507765644"

local swinging = false
local swingStep = 1
local zipStep = 1

local climbing = false
local climbEnabled = false

local swingConn = nil
local swingAnchor = nil
local swingRope = nil
local swingTrack = nil

local climbConn = nil
local climbTrack = nil
local climbVelocity = nil
local climbAlign = nil
local climbAttachment = nil

local webs = {}
local ikList = {}
local gripAtt = nil

------------------------------------------------
-- PERSONAGEM
------------------------------------------------

local function getParts()
	local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

	local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

	return char, hrp, hum
end

local function applyJump(char)
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

	hum.UseJumpPower = true
	hum.JumpPower = 100
end

if player.Character then
	task.spawn(applyJump, player.Character)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
	task.wait(0.5)
	applyJump(char)
end)

------------------------------------------------
-- ANIMAÇÃO
------------------------------------------------

local function getAnimator(hum)
	local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")

	if not animator then
		animator = Instance.new("Animator")
		animator.Parent = hum
	end

	return animator
end

------------------------------------------------
-- MÃOS
------------------------------------------------

local function getHand(char, side)

	if side == "Right" then
		return char:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
			or char:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
	end

	return char:FindFirstChild("LeftHand")
		or char:FindFirstChild("Left Arm")
end

------------------------------------------------
-- BRAÇOS
------------------------------------------------

local function getArmRoot(char, side)

	if side == "Right" then
		return char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperArm")
			or char:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
			or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
	end

	return char:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperArm")
		or char:FindFirstChild("Left Arm")
		or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
end

------------------------------------------------
-- LIMPAR TEIAS
------------------------------------------------

local function clearWebs()

	for _, obj in ipairs(webs) do
		if obj and obj.Parent then
			obj:Destroy()
		end
	end

	table.clear(webs)
end

------------------------------------------------
-- LIMPAR IK
------------------------------------------------

local function clearIK()

	for _, ik in ipairs(ikList) do
		if ik and ik.Parent then
			ik:Destroy()
		end
	end

	table.clear(ikList)
end

------------------------------------------------
-- SOM
------------------------------------------------

local function playSound(hrp, id)

	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")

	sound.SoundId = id
	sound.Volume = 2
	sound.Parent = hrp

	sound:Play()

	Debris:AddItem(sound, 3)
end

------------------------------------------------
-- CRIAR TEIA
------------------------------------------------

local function addWebFromHand(char, targetAtt, side)

	local hand = getHand(char, side)

	if not hand or not targetAtt then
		return
	end

	local handAtt = Instance.new("Attachment")
	handAtt.Name = "WebHandAttachment"
	handAtt.Parent = hand

	local beam = Instance.new("Beam")

	beam.Attachment0 = targetAtt
	beam.Attachment1 = handAtt

	beam.Width0 = 0.18
	beam.Width1 = 0.10

	beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(
		Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
	)

	beam.LightEmission = 1
	beam.FaceCamera = true

	beam.Parent = hand

	table.insert(webs, beam)
	table.insert(webs, handAtt)
end

------------------------------------------------
-- IK DO BRAÇO
------------------------------------------------

local function attachArm(char, hum, side, targetAtt)

	local hand = getHand(char, side)
	local root = getArmRoot(char, side)

	if not hand or not root or not targetAtt then
		return
	end

	local ik = Instance.new("IKControl")

	ik.Name = "WebArmIK_" .. side
	ik.Type = Enum.IKControlType.Position

	ik.EndEffector = hand
	ik.ChainRoot = root
	ik.Target = targetAtt

	ik.Weight = 1
	ik.SmoothTime = 0.08

	ik.Parent = hum

	table.insert(ikList, ik)
end

------------------------------------------------
-- UI
------------------------------------------------

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

gui.Name = "SpiderUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true

gui.Parent = playerGui

------------------------------------------------
-- BOTÃO DE ESCALAR
------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------
-- DETECTAR PAREDE
------------------------------------------------

local function getWall()

	local char, hrp = getParts()

	local params = RaycastParams.new()

	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char}

	params.IgnoreWater = true

	local directions = {
		hrp.CFrame.LookVector,
		-hrp.CFrame.LookVector,
		hrp.CFrame.RightVector,
		-hrp.CFrame.RightVector
	}

	local closestResult = nil
	local closestDistance = math.huge

	for _, direction in ipairs(directions) do

		local result = Workspace:Raycast(
			hrp.Position,
			direction * 3.5,
			params
		)

		if result then

			local distance =
				(result.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude

			if distance < closestDistance then
				closestDistance = distance
				closestResult = result
			end
		end
	end

	return closestResult
end

------------------------------------------------
-- PARAR ESCALADA
------------------------------------------------

local function stopClimb()

	if not climbing then
		return
	end

	climbing = false

	if climbConn then
		climbConn:Disconnect()
		climbConn = nil
	end

	if climbTrack then
		if climbTrack.IsPlaying then
			climbTrack:Stop(0.15)
		end

		climbTrack = nil
	end

	if climbVelocity then
		climbVelocity:Destroy()
		climbVelocity = nil
	end

	if climbAlign then
		climbAlign:Destroy()
		climbAlign = nil
	end

	if climbAttachment then
		climbAttachment:Destroy()
		climbAttachment = nil
	end

	local char, hrp, hum = getParts()

	hum.AutoRotate = true
	hum.PlatformStand = false

	hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
end

------------------------------------------------
-- COMEÇAR ESCALADA
------------------------------------------------

local function startClimb()

	if climbing or not climbEnabled then
		return
	end

	local char, hrp, hum = getParts()

	local wall = getWall()

	if not wall then
		return
	end

	climbing = true

	hum.AutoRotate = false
	hum.PlatformStand = false

	------------------------------------------------
	-- ANIMAÇÃO DE ESCALADA R15
	------------------------------------------------

	local animator = getAnimator(hum)

	local anim = Instance.new("Animation")

	anim.AnimationId =
		CLIMB_ANIM

	climbTrack =
		animator:LoadAnimation(anim)

	climbTrack.Priority =
		Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4

	climbTrack.Looped = true

	climbTrack:Play(0.1)

	-- FORÇA O HUMANOID PARA O ESTADO DE ESCALADA
	hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing)

	------------------------------------------------
	-- CONTROLE DE VELOCIDADE
	------------------------------------------------

	climbAttachment =
		Instance.new("Attachment")

	climbAttachment.Name =
		"SpiderClimbAttachment"

	climbAttachment.Parent = hrp

	climbVelocity =
		Instance.new("LinearVelocity")

	climbVelocity.Name =
		"SpiderClimbVelocity"

	climbVelocity.MaxForce =
		math.huge

	climbVelocity.RelativeTo =
		Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World

	climbVelocity.VectorVelocity =
		Vector3.zero

	climbVelocity.Attachment0 =
		climbAttachment

	climbVelocity.Parent = hrp

	------------------------------------------------
	-- ORIENTAÇÃO
	------------------------------------------------

	climbAlign =
		Instance.new("AlignOrientation")

	climbAlign.Name =
		"SpiderClimbOrientation"

	climbAlign.Mode =
		Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment

	climbAlign.MaxTorque =
		math.huge

	climbAlign.Responsiveness =
		25

	climbAlign.RigidityEnabled =
		false

	climbAlign.Attachment0 =
		climbAttachment

	climbAlign.Parent = hrp

	------------------------------------------------
	-- CONTROLE
	------------------------------------------------

	climbConn =
		RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

			if not climbing then
				return
			end

			if not hrp.Parent then
				stopClimb()
				return
			end

			local currentWall = getWall()

			if not currentWall then
				stopClimb()
				return
			end

			local normal =
				currentWall.Normal

			------------------------------------------------
			-- CÂMERA
			------------------------------------------------

			local camera =
				Workspace.CurrentCamera

			local cameraForward =
				camera.CFrame.LookVector

			local cameraRight =
				camera.CFrame.RightVector

			------------------------------------------------
			-- MOVIMENTO DO JOYSTICK
			------------------------------------------------

			local move =
				hum.MoveDirection

			local horizontal =
				Vector3.new(
					move.X,
					0,
					move.Z
				)

			local vertical =
				0

			if horizontal.Magnitude > 0.05 then

				local forwardAmount =
					horizontal:Dot(cameraForward)

				vertical =
					forwardAmount
			end

			------------------------------------------------
			-- MOVIMENTO NA PAREDE
			------------------------------------------------

			local up =
				Vector3.new(0,1,0)

			local wallRight =
				cameraRight

			wallRight =
				wallRight
				- normal * wallRight:Dot(normal)

			if wallRight.Magnitude > 0.01 then
				wallRight =
					wallRight.Unit
			end

			local climbUp =
				up * vertical * 8

			local climbSide =
				wallRight
				* move:Dot(wallRight)
				* 8

			local velocity =
				climbUp + climbSide

			------------------------------------------------
			-- MANTER NO PAREDÃO
			------------------------------------------------

			velocity +=
				-normal * 3

			climbVelocity.VectorVelocity =
				velocity

			------------------------------------------------
			-- VIRAR PARA A PAREDE
			------------------------------------------------

			local facing =
				-normal

			local look =
				Vector3.new(
					facing.X,
					0,
					facing.Z
				)

			if look.Magnitude > 0.01 then

				climbAlign.CFrame =
					CFrame.lookAt(
						Vector3.zero,
						look.Unit
					)
			end

			------------------------------------------------
			-- MANTER ESTADO DE ESCALADA
			------------------------------------------------

			if hum:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing then
				hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing)
			end
		end)
end

------------------------------------------------
-- BOTÃO DE ESCALADA
------------------------------------------------

btnClimb.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()

	climbEnabled =
		not climbEnabled

	if climbEnabled then

		local wall = getWall()

		if wall then
			startClimb()
		end

	else

		stopClimb()

	end
end)

------------------------------------------------
-- PARAR BALANÇO
------------------------------------------------

local function stopSwing()

	if not swinging then
		return
	end

	swinging = false

	if swingConn then
		swingConn:Disconnect()
		swingConn = nil
	end

	if swingTrack then
		if swingTrack.IsPlaying then
			swingTrack:Stop(0.2)
		end
	end

	clearIK()
	clearWebs()

	local char, hrp, hum = getParts()

	hum.PlatformStand = false
	hum.JumpPower = 100

	if swingRope then
		swingRope:Destroy()
		swingRope = nil
	end

	if swingAnchor then
		swingAnchor:Destroy()
		swingAnchor = nil
	end

	gripAtt = nil

	swingStep += 1

	if swingStep > 3 then
		swingStep = 1
	end
end

------------------------------------------------
-- COMEÇAR BALANÇO
------------------------------------------------

local function startSwing()

	if swinging then
		return
	end

	swinging = true

	local char, hrp, hum = getParts()

	hum.PlatformStand = true

	local animator = getAnimator(hum)

	if not swingTrack then

		local anim = Instance.new("Animation")

		anim.AnimationId = SWING_ANIM

		swingTrack =
			animator:LoadAnimation(anim)

		swingTrack.Priority =
			Enum.AnimationPriority.Action

		swingTrack.Looped = true
	end

	swingTrack:Play(0.15)

	playSound(hrp, SWING_SOUND)

	------------------------------------------------
	-- PONTO DA TEIA
	------------------------------------------------

	swingAnchor = Instance.new("Part")

	swingAnchor.Name = "WebAnchor"

	swingAnchor.Anchored = true
	swingAnchor.CanCollide = false
	swingAnchor.Transparency = 1

	swingAnchor.Size =
		Vector3.new(0.2,0.2,0.2)

	swingAnchor.Position =
		hrp.Position
		+ hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 36
		+ Vector3.new(0,13,0)

	swingAnchor.Parent = Workspace

	local a0 =
		Instance.new("Attachment")

	a0.Parent = swingAnchor

	local a1 =
		Instance.new("Attachment")

	a1.Parent = hrp

	swingRope =
		Instance.new("RopeConstraint")

	swingRope.Attachment0 = a0
	swingRope.Attachment1 = a1

	swingRope.Length =
		(swingAnchor.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude

	swingRope.Visible = false

	swingRope.Parent = hrp

	if swingStep == 1 then

		addWebFromHand(char,a0,"Right")
		attachArm(char,hum,"Right",a0)

	elseif swingStep == 2 then

		addWebFromHand(char,a0,"Left")
		attachArm(char,hum,"Left",a0)

	else

		addWebFromHand(char,a0,"Right")
		addWebFromHand(char,a0,"Left")

		attachArm(char,hum,"Right",a0)
		attachArm(char,hum,"Left",a0)

	end

	hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity +=
		hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 48

	swingConn =
		RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()

			if not swinging then
				return
			end

			if not hrp.Parent or not swingAnchor.Parent then
				return
			end

			local offset =
				swingAnchor.Position - hrp.Position

			if offset.Magnitude < 0.1 then
				return
			end

			local dir =
				offset.Unit

			local vel =
				hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity

			local radial =
				dir * vel:Dot(dir)

			hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
				(vel - radial)
				+ Vector3.new(
					0,
					-Workspace.Gravity * 0.03,
					0
				)
		end)
end

------------------------------------------------
-- WEB ZIP
------------------------------------------------

btnZip.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()

	stopSwing()

	local char, hrp, hum = getParts()

	local sides

	if zipStep == 1 then
		sides = {"Right"}

	elseif zipStep == 2 then
		sides = {"Left"}

	else
		sides = {"Right","Left"}
	end

	local tip = Instance.new("Part")

	tip.Name = "WebZipTarget"

	tip.Anchored = true
	tip.CanCollide = false
	tip.Transparency = 1

	tip.Size =
		Vector3.new(0.2,0.2,0.2)

	tip.Position =
		hrp.Position
		+ hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 34
		+ Vector3.new(0,12,0)

	tip.Parent = Workspace

	local tipAtt =
		Instance.new("Attachment")

	tipAtt.Parent = tip

	for _, side in ipairs(sides) do

		addWebFromHand(
			char,
			tipAtt,
			side
		)

		attachArm(
			char,
			hum,
			side,
			tipAtt
		)
	end

	playSound(hrp, ZIP_SOUND)

	local push =
		Instance.new("BodyVelocity")

	push.MaxForce =
		Vector3.new(
			1e7,
			1e7,
			1e7
		)

	push.Velocity =
		hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 120
		+ Vector3.new(0,55,0)

	push.Parent = hrp

	Debris:AddItem(tip,0.32)
	Debris:AddItem(push,0.28)

	task.delay(0.32,function()

		clearWebs()
		clearIK()

	end)

	zipStep += 1

	if zipStep > 3 then
		zipStep = 1
	end
end)

------------------------------------------------
-- CONTROLES
------------------------------------------------

btnSwing.MouseButton1Down:Connect(
	startSwing
)

btnSwing.MouseButton1Up:Connect(
	stopSwing
)

btnSwing.MouseLeave:Connect(
	stopSwing
)

------------------------------------------------
-- RESPAWN
------------------------------------------------

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()

	if swinging then
		stopSwing()
	end

	if climbing then
		stopClimb()
	end

	climbEnabled = false

	swingStep = 1
	zipStep = 1

end)

-- Massive Top-Screen Stylized Cooldown Banner (Initially Hidden)
local CdAlert = Instance.new("TextLabel", G)
CdAlert.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 90)
CdAlert.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 10)
CdAlert.BackgroundTransparency = 1
CdAlert.Text = ""
CdAlert.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
CdAlert.TextSize = 45
CdAlert.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
CdAlert.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
CdAlert.Visible = false

-- 7-Second Roblox Error & Rate-Limit Handler with Screen Alert
local function triggerErrorCooldown()
    if isLimited then return end
    isLimited = true
    CdAlert.Visible = true
    
    task.spawn(function()
        for i = 7, 1, -1 do
            if CdAlert and CdAlert.Parent then
                CdAlert.Text = "ROBLOX RATE LIMIT! PAUSED: " .. tostring(i) .. "s"
            end
            task.wait(1)
        end
        isLimited = false
        CdAlert.Visible = false
    end)
end

local function send(m)
    if isLimited then return end
    task.spawn(function()
        if T.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
            local ch = T:FindFirstChild("TextChannels")
            local c = ch and (ch:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral") or ch:FindFirstChild("RBXSystem"))
            if c then 
                local ok, err = pcall(function() c:SendAsync(m) end)
                if not ok or (err and (err:lower():find("wait") or err:lower():find("rate") or err:lower():find("error"))) then
                    triggerErrorCooldown()
                end
            elseif T:FindFirstChild("ChatInputBarConfiguration") and T.ActiveTextBox then
                T.ActiveTextBox.Text = m 
                game:GetService("VirtualUser"):TypeKey(13)
            end
        else
            local s = R:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents") and R.DefaultChatSystemChatEvents:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
            if s then s:FireServer(m, "All") end
        end
    end)
end

-- Listen for chat system warning messages to automatically trigger the 7-second cooldown
if T and T.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
    T.MessageReceived:Connect(function(r)
        local msg = (r.Text or ""):lower()
        if msg:find("must wait") or msg:find("sending another message") or msg:find("error") then

-- Smooth Dragging
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
MainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)
MainFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)

-- Velocity Logic
local velConnection = nil
local isEnabled = false
local speedMultiplier = 1

local function StopVelocity()
    if velConnection then
        velConnection:Disconnect()
        velConnection = nil
    end
    isEnabled = false
    BtnTextLabel.Text = "Enable Speed"
    BtnGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(0, 160, 245)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(0, 80, 180))
    })
    StatusLabel.Text = "Status: Disabled"
    StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 225, 255)
end

local function StartVelocity()
    local val = tonumber(SpeedBox.Text)
    if not val or val <= 0 then
        StatusLabel.Text = "Error: Enter a valid number!"
        StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
        return
    end

    speedMultiplier = val
    if velConnection then velConnection:Disconnect() end

    velConnection = RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char then
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            if hum and root and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                local currentY = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
                local moveDir = hum.MoveDirection
                local baseSpeed = hum.WalkSpeed
                
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
                    moveDir.X * (baseSpeed * speedMultiplier),
                    currentY,
                    moveDir.Z * (baseSpeed * speedMultiplier)
                )
            end
        end
    end)

    isEnabled = true
    BtnTextLabel.Text = "Disable Speed"
    BtnGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(230, 60, 80)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(160, 20, 40))
    })
    StatusLabel.Text = "Velocity Active: " .. tostring(speedMultiplier) .. "x"
    StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 160)
end

ToggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if isEnabled then
        StopVelocity()
    else
        StartVelocity()
    end
end)

-- Respawn Support
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    if isEnabled then
        task.wait(0.5)
        StartVelocity()
    end
end)
